description: This file contains server-side code-behind logic for the TheoryExam page in an online examination system. It handles page load initialization, database interactions for fetching exam questions, submitting answers, navigation, and timer countdown functionality.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam page, handling user interactions and database operations related to the theory exam.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the page, checks user session, fetches questions from the database, and sets the exam timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on the course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Processes and stores the submitted answers, updates queues and records in the database, and navigates to the dashboard.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles timeout event.
